title: Hollyhock-Hued Italian Bowtie Pasta
description: A flavorful Italian dish featuring bowtie pasta, kombu-cold-extract, and a hint of lemon, all served in a molcajete.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bowtie pasta according to package instructions.
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until they start to release their juices.
Stir in the kombu-cold-extract and cook for an additional minute.
When the pasta is done cooking, reserve 1 cup of pasta water and then drain the pasta.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the tomato mixture and toss to combine.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a molcajete and top with grated parmesan and chopped parsley.
